note: Plan EX lenses (Neal 2026-11-17): curated ways into a subject, not partitions. An article joins every lens whose criteria it meets, from any subject in the lens's `in` (default its own). A lens is a list of clauses (`any`); an article joins when one clause holds, and a clause holds when all its keys do: `seeds` (its sub-category by facets.py, facets.json), `classes` (a thing's P31/P279/P136 reach one within the spec depth, P279 up), `occupations` (one of a person's P106; only people whose main subject is in `main`, default `in`), `genres` (one of its P136), `not_classes`/`not_occupations` (none reached), `after`/`before` (the item's year: a thing's start or date, a person's birth + 40), `things` (any non-person), `not_main` (main subject not one of these). An article no clause places stays in its subject's whole listing only: a neighbours' vote was tried and was wrong about a third of the time (2026-11-17). Labels sit beside the QIDs for reading; the build checks them. Nothing is set per article. `desc_en`/`desc_es` are the room's one-line description (Plan EX P0, Neal OK 2026-11-17): what the room holds, no claims; not yet in the index meta.
